Inspection of the vehicle shows scraping and deformation along the right rear quarter panel, with a cracked tail lamp lens and a
scuffed rear bumper cover on the same side. The pattern of contact is consistent with the sideswipe described during a lane

cover, the tail lamp assembly, and straightening the quarter panel with refinishing to match. The labor hours on the estimate fit
the scope of this work. Nothing in our records or the owner's history points to earlier damage in these areas, and the invoices
submitted contain no repeated charges.
